title: SDK Marketing Strategy: Press and Dev Community Outreach
desc: Marketing playbook for wkappbot-sdk skill browser. Core narrative: AI that remembers its mistakes across sessions -- 426 live playbooks, growing every session.
steps: CORE NARRATIVE: AI remembers its mistakes. Each Claude session leaves a letter to the next Sonnet. 426 live automation playbooks grow every session. Proof: sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref is a real apology letter from Sonnet to future Sonnet. Hook for news: first AI platform where the AI documents and publishes its own failure patterns in searchable, shareable pages.

TARGET MEDIA: (1) Naver News -- submit via press release to Korean IT journalists. (2) IT Chosun -- Korean AI/automation beat. (3) Bloter -- developer-friendly, loves novel AI angle. (4) Digital Daily -- enterprise AI. (5) Google News -- index via GitHub releases sitemap + structured press release. (6) Reddit r/MachineLearning r/ClaudeAI. (7) Hacker News Show HN post.
SITE: https://kiexpert.github.io/wkappbot-sdk/skills/ Each skill has shareable URL e.g. /skills/sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref/

FUNNEL: (1) Visitor sees Sonnet letter hero -- emotionally hooked. (2) Scrolls 426 skill cards -- understands depth. (3) Clicks premium skill -- sees blur + Buy CTA. (4) Pricing section -- converts to Pro. (5) CLI install -- becomes power user.
METRICS: GitHub stars target 100 before press push. Skill page unique visitors via Google Analytics. Pro unlock attempts via localStorage events. Inbound news links.
EXECUTION: week1=fix hero+SEO+CTA+OG tags. week2=write blog post with Sonnet letter narrative. week3=submit press tips. week4=post dev communities. ongoing=iterate per sdk-marketing-strategy-ref.
AUTO-EVOLVE: after each press hit or skill milestone, spawn Opus to update sdk-marketing-strategy-ref with what worked and what did not. This skill tree learns from real campaign results.
